detailed_description: Word to Text converter extracts plain text content from Microsoft Word documents (.docx). Upload your Word file and get clean text output instantly. Perfect for extracting content without formatting.
usage_steps: Open the Word to Text tool page
Drag and drop a DOCX file or click to select
Wait for text extraction to complete
Copy the extracted text or download as TXT file
usage_examples: Extract text from Word documents for analysis
Convert formatted documents to plain text
Copy content from Word files quickly
